text:
A solution containing hydroxide ions, OH–(aq), is added to a solution containing hydrogen ions,
H+(aq). An equation representing the reaction is shown.
H+(aq)  +  OH–(aq)  →  H2O(l)
Which statement about the reaction is correct?
A
The hydrogen ions represent an alkali.
B
The reaction is a neutralisation reaction.
C
The reaction is a reduction.
As the OH– ions are added, the pH of the reaction mixture falls.
D

options.label: A
options.text: The hydrogen ions represent an alkali.

options.label: B
options.text: The reaction is a neutralisation reaction.

options.label: D
options.text: As the OH– ions are added, the pH of the reaction mixture falls.
